A practical framework for evaluating the whole system.","excerptZh":"从9月1日的模型与企业防护公告出发，讨论为什么模型能力、缓存成本、执行框架和数据处理边界需要放在一起评估。","tags":["Claude Fable 5.1","Enterprise AI","Agents","Evaluation"],"readTime":"6 min","sections":[{"heading":{"en":"The release is a system-level change","zh":"新闻焦点：发布的不只是一个模型名称"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Anthropic's September 1 announcements introduce Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 alongside Enterprise Frontier Safeguards. The model announcement describes Fable and Mythos as the same model with different safeguards and access policies: general availability for Fable, restricted programs for Mythos. Those access conditions matter when interpreting capability claims.","zh":"Anthropic在9月1日的公告中介绍Claude Fable 5.1、Mythos 5.1，以及Enterprise Frontier Safeguards。模型公告表示，Fable和Mythos是同一模型，但防护措施和访问政策不同：Fable普遍开放，Mythos通过受限项目提供。理解能力声明时，必须同时考虑这些访问条件。"},{"en":"The announcement also discusses lower cache-read costs and estimates workload savings. A percentage reduction in typical spending is not a universal reduction in every token price. How much a deployment saves depends on reusable context, output length, and how many attempts are needed to finish the job.","zh":"公告还讨论了缓存读取费用下降及其带来的工作负载成本预估。典型任务支出降低某个百分比，并不等于所有token单价都按同样幅度下降。实际节省多少，取决于上下文复用、输出长度，以及完成工作所需的尝试次数。"}],"sources":[1,2]},{"heading":{"en":"Reason about a complete task budget","zh":"成本分析：为完整任务建立预算"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"For planning, split spend into uncached input, cached input, output, tool execution, and retries. Then divide by accepted tasks. This avoids two misleading comparisons: a cheap model that needs repeated repair, and a powerful model whose benchmark result assumes a much larger reasoning budget than the product can afford.","zh":"规划时，可以把支出拆成未缓存输入、缓存输入、输出、工具执行与重试，再除以验收通过的任务数。这样能避免两类误判：便宜模型因反复修补而变贵，以及强模型的评测成绩依赖产品根本承担不起的推理预算。"},{"en":"A reasonable trial would use short, medium, and long repository tasks under the same wall-clock cap. Record accepted patches, regressions, review effort, and total cost. Keep the harness fixed when comparing model versions, then run a separate experiment for a harness upgrade. Otherwise model and orchestration improvements become impossible to distinguish.","zh":"一个合理的试验是，在相同总时间上限下运行短、中、长三类仓库任务，记录可接受补丁、回归、审阅投入和总成本。比较模型版本时固定执行框架，再单独测试框架升级。否则，模型提升和编排改进就会混在一起。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"Data control requires reading the rollout conditions","zh":"数据边界：需要读清楚推出条件"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Anthropic describes EFS as storing data in customer-controlled cloud infrastructure, with a phased rollout beginning later in the fall and interim zero-data-retention access for eligible customers. This is a deployment plan with eligibility conditions, not proof that every account already has the same arrangement.","zh":"Anthropic把EFS描述为将数据存放于客户控制的云基础设施中，计划于秋季稍晚分阶段推出，并为符合条件的客户提供过渡期零数据保留访问。这是一项带有资格条件的部署计划，不能据此认为所有账户已经自动获得同样安排。"},{"en":"For an enterprise integration, map where prompts, tool results, browser traces, logs, and generated artifacts travel. A model-provider setting covers only part of that path. The product team still needs to specify who can inspect records, how long each component retains them, and which tools can contact external systems.","zh":"企业集成应画清提示词、工具结果、浏览器轨迹、日志和生成产物的流向。模型提供方的某项设置，只覆盖这条链路的一部分。产品团队仍需明确谁能查看记录、各组件保留多久，以及哪些工具能够访问外部系统。"}],"sources":[3]},{"heading":{"en":"What I would put in the acceptance report","zh":"验收报告应该回答什么"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"My acceptance report would separate capability, operational behavior, and data handling. Capability asks whether the output passes independent tests. Operational behavior asks whether the agent recovers from failures without losing constraints. Data handling asks whether the actual configured path matches the intended boundary. A model launch is a good reason to rerun this report; it cannot replace the report.","zh":"我会把验收报告分成能力、运行行为和数据处理三部分。能力回答产物是否通过独立测试；运行行为回答遇到故障后是否能恢复且保留约束；数据处理回答实际配置的链路是否符合预期边界。新模型发布是重跑这份报告的理由，不能替代报告本身。"}]}],"sources":[{"title":"Anthropic — Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 announcement","date":"September 2026 launch","url":"https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1"},{"title":"Anthropic — Fable announcement chronology","date":"2026-09-01 entry","url":"https://www.anthropic.com/claude/fable"},{"title":"Anthropic — Enterprise Frontier Safeguards","date":"2026-09-01","url":"https://www.anthropic.com/news/enterprise-frontier-safeguards"}]}}],["$L7"],"$L8"]}],{},null,false,null]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,null],"$La",false]],"m":"$undefined","G":["$b",["$Lc"]],"S":true,"h":null,"s":"$undefined","l":"$undefined","p":"$undefined","d":"$undefined","b":"ekZJX53BQfdyxE9HisC-1"}
